title: Thermodynamic Modeling of NaOH Neutralization in Metal Sulfate Leachates: Code and Simulation Data
description: PHREEQC-based thermodynamic simulation framework for modeling NaOH neutralization and selective metal hydroxide precipitation from battery leachate solutions. Includes Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) design of experiments, automated PHREEQC input generation, speciation result parsing, and figure plotting scripts. Developed to support the associated journal article.
